initialValue: Join Rider on a magical adventure where friendship grows, courage shines, and being uniquely YOU becomes your greatest strength!

name: characterHeading
title: Characters: heading
initialValue: Friends who celebrate differences and discover strengths

name: characterIntro
title: Characters: introduction
initialValue: Each character brings a unique voice, personality, and perspective to Rider's world, creating opportunities for children to recognize their own strengths and celebrate the magic within themselves and others.

name: authorName
title: Author: name
initialValue: Dr. Tisha Shipley

name: authorBio1
title: Author: first paragraph
initialValue: Dr. Tisha Shipley is an educator, podcaster, author, and lifelong advocate for children. With more than 25 years of experience in early childhood and elementary education, Dr. Shipley has dedicated her career to helping children discover their strengths, celebrate their differences, and feel confident in who they are.

name: authorBio2
title: Author: second paragraph
initialValue: As a professor of Early Childhood Education, she brings her passion for social-emotional learning, developmentally appropriate practice, and inclusive classrooms into everything she creates. Rider's Magic Mark was inspired by the belief that what makes us different can also be what makes us extraordinary.

name: illustratorName
title: Illustrator: name
initialValue: Chandrani Das

name: illustratorBio1
title: Illustrator: first paragraph
initialValue: Chandrani Das is a children's book illustrator who loves bringing stories and characters to life through both traditional and digital art. She has been drawing since childhood and has worked professionally as an illustrator for the past five years, with more than 25 children's books illustrated so far.

name: illustratorBio2
title: Illustrator: second paragraph
initialValue: She enjoys exploring different illustration styles and mediums, from playful and whimsical children's artwork to detailed semi-realistic illustrations. One of her favorite parts of the process is creating expressive faces, playful poses, emotions, and little details that make each scene feel alive.

name: illustratorBio3
title: Illustrator: third paragraph
initialValue: Chandrani feels grateful to collaborate with wonderful authors and be part of their storytelling journeys. It was a joy to illustrate Rider's Magic Mark, and she hopes her illustrations add warmth, emotion, and a little extra magic to this beautiful story.
